rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing - split_once replaces split+collect+indexing
No unchecked arithmetic - checked_add for accumulator overflow
No unchecked division - checked_div with non-zero guarantee from empty check
No lossy as casts - u32::try_from for count conversion
Smallest change: renamed return type from Result<String> to Result<Summary>, added render_summary
residual_risk: count as u64 for checked_div divisor is a widening cast (usize to u64) which cannot lose data on any platform. All other casts use checked conversions. The unwrap_or(0) on checked_div is provably unreachable since count > 0 after the empty check.
